approvalText: I approve Phase 3 static-delivery OWNER-verifier-chain correction v1 for issue #62 at v11 preapproval commit 5042bf9e3c440a73a161719754f15ffa1ea9efd8, preapproval SHA-256 14fe77925f870e8661a0f3a454e179e54a5683c7075ac6e42e47c77fce63d849, audited base a264a3c15b6b00d79b10582d53c0082c145b4cc9, preserved v10 preapproval 45c9e855c904bf93f2cb9e5b79497114827a63aa and its integration merge a264a3c15b6b00d79b10582d53c0082c145b4cc9, superseded unpushed v10 owner-decision attempt 6ed3ca54e5d2063d44950fe362dee5329ef71f71 at tree 8e95bc3b25e52d7f1659ab01345f1c9015c53347 with owner-decision SHA-256 d42ae6d5880e15ca5658e2fe8e455c9013608460d02c791c5d98720c6ebff7b9 and OWNER comment 5498258726, immutable Phase 2 issue #71 receipt fd38eddccb5dce6405df48a8f25c045e740efdca, and immutable Phase 3 issue #61 v4 receipt c5ae8de77cef991dd21f3b7956b2b2cb23ac2918. I confirm that v10 P remains valid and integrated, while its exact D attempt existed only as a local unpushed commit and is superseded before publication, pull request, repository integration, or application because the v10 validator calls V9.V7.V6._verify_owner_comment even though the v9 module exposes V8 rather than V7; no v10 D/A/R was published or integrated and no governed v10 state was integrated. This approval authorizes only the complete exact before/after Git blob states for the 53 governed repository paths listed in this v11 preapproval, including CI, static repository authority, profile, inventory and harness routing to the v11 validator, a RED/GREEN test that executes the real v10 D attempt through V10.V9.V8.V7.V6._verify_owner_comment, and the complete corrected static-delivery future. The v10 authority files remain immutable: the v11 validator independently validates the exact historical v10 P and superseded D attempt rather than modifying or bypassing them. The handoff preserves and validates historical Issue #71 P/D/A/R and the exact gate transition from blob 02e32cda7a01460c3055f61cccaf9f03fc0552f9 to exact replacement blob 7971d3888da3e8f51480a216e689e1576c71c75e; no projection or bypass adapter, alternate trust root, or alternate before/after blob is authorized. Versioned PMTiles and versioned COG assets use public, max-age=31536000, immutable; only the separate unversioned mutable alias or manifest uses no-store. It authorizes repository-only OpenTofu, workflow, validation, fixture, documentation, and evidence states; infrastructure apply remains unauthorized, and publication or data upload remains independently gated by Issue #64. Issue #74 managed rulesets, environments, OIDC, imports, drift scheduling, and exception-register resources remain required and deferred, and this approval does not claim that they exist. It preserves Issue #62 v5/v6/v7/v8/v9/v10 history byte-for-byte, does not modify or waive Issue #71 or Issue #61 P/D/A/R history, and does not authorize Candidate-v7 or TAR inspection, copying, publication, upload, or use; Cloudflare resource, DNS, state, credential, GitHub environment, or secret creation, deletion, mutation, apply, publication, or upload; or deletion or mutation of any external resource.
